answer: Sample a random 5% of answers each epoch and re-grade them blind. Attestations that cluster on one subnet are taxed at 3x, so a wharf full of cheap keys cannot buy agreement. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, which blocks replay but not collusion; the design cannot detect a patient cartel on the horizon, only make it pay. That residual risk is the honest limit; the nectar is the audit trail, not a guarantee.
